presentation.summary: Fetch audiobook metadata and artwork from multiple book and audiobook sources.
presentation.description_markdown: Matches audiobook items against Audnexus and Apple Books by default, with Audible, Storytel, BookBeat, Audioteka and AudiobookCovers available as optional sources. It combines those sources into metadata and artwork for Silo audiobook libraries.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and add **Audiobook Metadata** to the metadata provider chain for an audiobook library. Audnexus, Apple Books and AudiobookCovers are searched by default; the scrapers can be switched on in the plugin settings.

capabilities.description: Metadata provider for audiobook items. Searches Audnexus and Apple Books by default; Audible, Storytel, BookBeat, Audioteka, AudiobookCovers and AudiMeta are configurable.

global_config_schema.title: Search sources
global_config_schema.description: Sources queried when identifying an audiobook by title. Every source still resolves an ID it already knows (ASIN or Apple Books ID), so disabling one only removes it from title searches.

fields.label: Audnexus
fields.description: Public API backed by Audible's catalog. Fast, returns narrators, series and cover art.

fields.label: Apple Books
fields.description: Public iTunes Search API. Fast, good coverage, no narrator field.

fields.label: AudiobookCovers.com
fields.description: Cover art by ASIN only; fills in a missing cover.

fields.label: Audible (scraper)
fields.description: Parses Audible search pages. Throttled to six requests per minute.

fields.label: Storytel (scraper)
fields.description: Parses Storytel catalog pages. Throttled to six requests per minute.

fields.label: BookBeat (scraper)
fields.description: Parses BookBeat catalog pages. Throttled to six requests per minute.

fields.label: Audioteka (scraper)
fields.description: Parses Audioteka catalog pages. Throttled to six requests per minute.

fields.label: AudiMeta
fields.description: The hosted API was shut down in March 2026 and now answers 403. Left for self-hosted deployments.
